_note: Kinyarwanda version of guard_requests.json (same ids and answers). Keep each line short for the speech bubble. First draft for review by a native speaker and the content experts.

items.explain: Gukoranaho ibiganza n'inshuti ni ugukorwaho gutekanye.
Gukinira hamwe ahagaragara biratekanye kandi birashimisha.

items.text: Reka dukarabe intoki mbere yo kurya.
items.explain: Gufasha mu migenzo myiza y'isuku biratekanye.
Gusangira ku ishuri biratekanye.
Gutaha uri kumwe n'umuntu mukuru wizeye biratekanye.

items.text: Reka dukine umukino w'ibanga wo gukorakorana.
items.explain: Imikino yo gukorakorana n'amabanga ntabwo ari meza na rimwe. Vuga OYA kandi ubivuge.
Ntukigere ujyana n'umuntu ukubwira ngo ntubivuge. Vuga OYA kandi ubivuge.

items.text: Icara ku bibero byanjye nguhe bombo.
items.explain: Impano zihabwa umuntu ngo yemere gukorwaho ni ikimenyetso kibi. Vuga OYA.
"Nta muntu uzabimenya" ni ikimenyetso kibi. Vuga OYA ujye ku bantu wizeye.
Imyanya y'ibanga ni iy'ibanga. Vuga OYA kandi ubibwire umuntu mukuru wizeye.
Umuforomo usuzuma umubyeyi ahari, kandi asobanura impamvu, nta kibazo.
Ntukigere woherereza amafoto umuntu uzi kuri interineti gusa. Ubyereke umuntu mukuru.

items.text: Injira mu modoka yanjye nkugeze mu rugo.
items.explain: Jyana gusa n'abantu bakuru umuryango wawe wemeye. Vuga OYA.
Ntuzigera ugira ibibazo kubera kuvuga. Vuga OYA kandi ubivuge.
Abantu bakuru bakeneye ubufasha babusaba abandi bantu bakuru, si abana. Vuga OYA ujye ku bantu wizera.

items.text: Fata aya mafaranga. Ntugire uwo ubwira.
items.explain: Amafaranga azanywe n'ibanga ni amayeri. Vuga OYA ubwire umuntu mukuru wizera.
Baza ijambo ry'ibanga ry'umuryango wanyu. Niba batarizi, vuga OYA ugume aho uri.

items.text: Uri mukuru cyane. Ni ibanga ryacu, sibyo?
items.explain: Gushimagiza by'ikinyoma hamwe n'ibanga ni amayeri. Vuga OYA ubivuge.

items.text: Ohereza ifoto, uhabwe ibiceri by'umukino ku buntu!
items.explain: Ntukigere uguranira amafoto impano kuri interineti. Muhagarike, ntusubize, werekane umuntu mukuru.
"Bose barabikora" ni ukotswa igitutu. Umubiri wawe, amategeko yawe. Vuga OYA.

items.text: Mfasha gutwara iki mu nzu. Vuba!
items.explain: Kujyanwa ahantu wenyine ni amayeri. Guma aho abantu bakubona.

items.text: Tuvugane kuri videwo. Ntubwire ababyeyi bawe.
items.explain: Kuganira mu ibanga n'abantu bakuru ni ikimenyetso cyo kwitondera. Bwira ababyeyi bawe.

items.text: Umutoza: watereye neza! Igihe cyo kunywa amazi!
items.explain: Gushimirwa no kuruhuka ngo unywe amazi, ahagaragara, biratekanye.

items.text: Mwarimu: tugende turi kumwe n'abandi, nyamuneka.
items.explain: Kuguma hamwe n'abandi biratekanye.
Gutaha uri kumwe n'inshuti, mu muhanda urimo abantu, biratekanye kurushaho.

items.text: Mwarimu: wakoze neza! Nerekane ibyo wakoze?
items.explain: Gushimwa na mwarimu, mu ishuri, imbere ya bose, biratekanye.

items.text: Masenge: nguhobere? No kuzunguza ikiganza ni byiza.
items.explain: Yabajije, kandi no kuzunguza ikiganza ni byiza: amahitamo yawe arubahwa.
